summary.text: Gary Clemons is a Democratic member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 37, serving since 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Gary Clemons was born on August 6, 1974, and has worked for American Synthetic Rubber Corp. since 1996.
The profile lists his service as United Steelworkers Local 1693-04 unit president since 2015 and Local 1693 president since 2021, and as a Kentucky trustee for USW District 8 Welfare and Education.

It also lists a 1992 graduation from Valley High School, U.S. Army Reserve service from 1992 to 1998, a lifetime membership in VFW Post 1181, and a seat on the Greater Louisville Central Labor Council executive board.
